description: This script manages LED indicators during different system states, such as preinitialization, failsafe, and completion, for a device running OpenWrt.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Finds the LED device file for specific status indicators (dmz, power, diag, wps).

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the system LED state based on the input argument, indicating various system phases.
